purpose: actual per-step measurement inside switch windows; display-only axis changes; no treatment retuning
probe_methods: unchanged original fitters, labels, roles, classes, mu/z and fixed noise; all arrived image groups retained

timing.controlled: post-update current-stage native theta with changing step-seeded80/20 split, same historical definition

controlled_verification: all original logged losses, native probe values, 15 checkpoint hashes and final weights must match; extra probes preserve model and all RNGs
missing_policy: never interpolate or invent a probe observation; fail case if exact replay cannot be verified
y_axis: raw task accuracy or BA, automatic local range, clipped axis explicitly labeled; not percent change or z-score
legends: each panel labels every metric curve; vertical boundary between final old and first new batch
fairness: all original seeds and dimensions preserved, no expected-shape filtering
stage_info: legacy Xi keeps known-stage routing; not a blind detector claim
